p: bitter: He shows the just cause of his complaining and concerning that Eliphaz had exhorted him to return to God, Job 22:21 he declares that he desires nothing more, but it seems that God would not be found of him.
plead against me with his great: Using his absolute power and saying because I am God, I may do what I will.
put strength in me: Of his mercy he would give me power to answer him.
There the righteous might dispute with: When he of his mercy has given strength to maintain their cause.
Behold: Meaning, that if he considers God's justice, he is not able to comprehend his judgments on what side or whatever part he turns himself.
way that I take: God has this preeminence about me, that he knows my way: that is, that I am not able to judge his work, he shows also his confidence, that God uses him for his profit.
esteemed the words of his mouth: His word is more precious to me than the meat with which the body is sustained.
turn him: Job confesses that at the present he did not feel God's favour and yet was assured that God had appointed him to a good end.
many such things are with him: In many points man is not able to attain to God's judgments.
God maketh my heart soft: That I should not be without fear.
darkness: He shows the cause for his fear, which is, that he being in trouble sees no end, nor yet knows the cause.
